text: Conflicting numbers: the 2027 minimum-wage mechanism ceiling is given as €672.80 in Медиапоол/strategy.bg material and €672.84 by АИКБ — €12.80 above the €660 adopted either way; the VAT threshold in force is quoted as €51,130 by some outlets and "~51 300" by others; the €2,400 social-insurance ceiling for 2027 is still a finance-ministry budget-drafting assumption (capital.bg, 22 October), not an adopted act — do not quote it as decided.
